parameters.query:
SELECT id, title, company, city, work_model, description, source, source_url
FROM public.jobs
WHERE match_score IS NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN source = 'Jooble' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id DESC
LIMIT 3;

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.jobs
SET match_score = $2,
    ai_recommendation = $3,
    ai_summary = $4,
    matched_skills = $5::jsonb,
    missing_skills = $6::jsonb,
    ai_analyzed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, title, company, city, match_score, ai_recommendation, matched_skills, missing_skills;

SELECT title, company, city, match_score, ai_recommendation AS recommendation, matched_skills, missing_skills
FROM public.jobs
WHERE match_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY match_score DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 10;
